verdicts.explanation: The 0.49 mS cm−1 value at 298 K and 0.41 eV belong to the as-prepared BM-LYC sample, which the paper measured itself by EIS. The paper describes these as total pellet conductivity, and relative density is correctly left null because 76-79% is given for the pellets generally.

verdicts.explanation: Material, 0.067 mS cm−1 at 298 K, 0.47 eV, total kind and experimental origin all match the SS-LYC sample. The 550 °C / 6-day treatment is the solid-state synthesis anneal, which the record's own notes call a synthesis step, so the sintering fields should be null; 144 h is also only a unit conversion of 6 days.
The 0.12 mS cm−1 value for the β-phase is attributed in the text to Ito et al. EIS work, so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature for this value, so null is right.
The 0.014 mS cm−1 value for the α-phase comes from the Ito et al. study that the paper cites, so literature_cited is correct. No measurement temperature is stated, so null is right.

The ≈0.51 mS cm−1 value is attributed in the Introduction to Asano et al. (Ref. 10), so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature or method for it, so those nulls are right.
